<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Send as you read: a replay is a stream of bounded pages, never one collected vector, so the cost of an attach is bounded by a page and the first frame arrives quickly. The cursor contract, wire format and dedupe stay exactly as they are. A repeated failure is logged once per cause. |
| composition_root | — |
| contracts | — |

| rk-0001 | A page boundary drops or repeats an event. | Keyset by seq; tests at boundaries and during concurrent appends; mutant. |
